# Presentation-email template contract

Owned by `modules/write-up/GUIDE.md` and `assets/submission_email_template.html`.

- Use the native subject field and one short HTML body. Named and MPC subjects follow the owning guide.
- Include only confirmed normalized fields. The external submission uses `Reason for Leaving` as its required field, with confirmed wording or a blank/omitted value. `Reason for Exploring` is optional internal source capture only and must never substitute for it.
- Preserve the external field set: Name, Title, Compensation Target, Current Compensation, Vacation, Location, Work Status, Interview Availability, Start Date, Reason for Leaving, and Profile Summary.
- Keep the field order locked. Add no ad hoc candidate labels. The only declared exceptions are the opt-in `Contact` line below and an optional `Clarifier Note` after the Profile Summary when a real, decision-relevant concern needs honest context; delete it when no such concern exists.
- Profile highlights are adaptive, usually 3 to 5 source-backed points. Never pad to hit a count, and never use generic praise.
- Contact is opt-in and host-supplied. Never put contact information in the resume. Never expose real employer names in an external blind MPC.
- Bold only JD-driven proof points. End exactly with `CV attached.` on its own line; do not type a signature. Create one unsent draft, verify saved recipients, body, and attachment.
- Inherit `ja-style.md`: concise human wording, no em/en dashes, tildes, semicolons, double hyphens, or spaces around slashes.
